brief:
Al Jazeera English reported that "Who Is Still Alive," a film with Palestinian stories, has been selected as Switzerland's official entry for Best International Film at the 2027 Academy Awards. The selection marks a major presence of Palestinian narratives at the upcoming Oscars ceremony.

The outlet spoke with the film's director and cast about the submission, though details of their comments were not specified in the available summary.
dek: Al Jazeera spoke to the director and cast of Who Is Still Alive, Switzerland’s Oscar entry for Best International Film.
title: Palestinian film wins Swiss Oscar submission for 2027 ceremony
